body: O3 CURRENT-CODE BOUNDARY, read-only evidence for child slicing. `storymodel4s.view.ProjectionKind` currently has exactly `DiscourseAtlas`; `AxisMeaning` has only `DiscourseOffset` and `ContextLane`; `DistanceMeaning` has only `NoMeaning`; and `AtlasSpec` has no projection selector. `CommonViewState.relationLayers` nevertheless accepts every `RelationLayer`, including `WorldTime`, while `AtlasCompiler` emits routes only for Causal and Goal. A request containing WorldTime can therefore compile successfully to the same scene as if that requested layer were absent. The model itself has context-scoped Allen temporal relations and explicitly says a later real-valued timeline is only a layout of those edges, never their replacement. CONSEQUENCE: the agreed two-coordinate answer cannot be only an HTML/JavaScript task. Cut the spec into (a) a storymodel4s typed projection/capability outcome and chronology contract, then (b) StoryAtlas lowering and linked interaction. Acceptance law: requesting WorldTime must either produce a declared chronology projection preserving context, partial/unclear relations, status and evidence, or return a typed unsupported/unrendered-layer outcome that reaches result.json and preview status. It must never succeed by silently omitting the selected layer. This is D3 at the projection boundary, not a renderer preference.
